title: A static target="_blank" link declares rel="noopener"
intent: Without rel=noopener the opened page holds a window.opener reference to the app — the reverse-tabnabbing primitive. The rule enforces the safe default on every statically-authored external link.

runtime.rationale: An authored static target=_blank without rel is a source form; the residual risk it addresses is legacy-engine reverse-tabnabbing, fixable only where the anchor is written. Modern engines default to noopener behaviour, and raw anchors are refused wholesale in app modules regardless.
